notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI carries the full MSG_RAID_TARGET_UPDATE wire (set/request outbound, single + full-list inbound parse) and maintains the 8-slot guid board with correct clear-on-leave semantics, but nothing renders a raid mark anywhere: no overhead world billboard, no target-frame icon, and the Lua-facing RaidTargetIndex helper has no caller.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The state layer is done and matches the reference wire (0xff request body, icon+guid set body, list terminator); only presentation is absent, so a player in a marked group sees nothing.
